hero.subtitle: ENTERPRISE SECURITY
hero.description: At Dragolink, security isn't an afterthought. Our entire infrastructure is designed from the ground up to protect your links, your users, and your data at global scale. Zero trust, 100% visibility.

features.title: SSO & SAML
features.description: Enterprise-grade security integrations supporting SAML, Okta, and Azure AD for seamless, secure identity management.

features.title: End-to-End Encryption
features.description: All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), ensuring absolute privacy and data sovereignty.

features.title: Granular Role-Based Access (RBAC)
features.description: Define custom roles and permissions down to the workspace and individual link level to enforce principle of least privilege.

sections.title: Infrastructure Security
sections.content:
Our infrastructure is hosted on top-tier cloud providers with physically secured data centers. We employ a defense-in-depth approach, utilizing virtual private clouds (VPCs), strict firewall rules, and automated intrusion detection systems. All compute resources are isolated, ensuring that enterprise tenants operate in completely separated environments to prevent any cross-contamination of analytics or user data.

Furthermore, our architecture is designed for high availability and fault tolerance. In the event of localized failures, traffic is automatically routed to healthy nodes across multiple availability zones, ensuring 99.99% uptime for your critical links.

sections.title: Data Privacy & GDPR
sections.content:
Privacy is at the core of our platform. We strictly adhere to global privacy frameworks, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). By default, we anonymize user IP addresses and do not collect personally identifiable information (PII) beyond what is strictly necessary to route and analyze link traffic.

Customers maintain full ownership of their data. We provide self-serve data deletion, export tools, and automated data retention policies to help you maintain compliance with your internal privacy guidelines.

sections.title: Incident Response & Threat Intelligence
sections.content:
Our security operations center operates 24/7/365. We utilize automated threat intelligence feeds, including Google Safe Browsing and PhishTank, to dynamically scan every link created on our platform. If a link is identified as malicious, it is instantly disabled and quarantined, protecting your users from phishing, malware, and spam.

In the unlikely event of a security incident, our dedicated incident response team follows a rigorous playbook to identify, contain, and eradicate threats. We are committed to transparent communication and will notify impacted customers well within regulatory timelines.
